items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Right here in Houston. With Milt Larkin's band.

ctx.x: So that went on. That was in '39. So this is in '42, I'm getting to. That is 3 years later, and he still wants me. See, Illinois had cussed him out and he wanted to get rid of him.
Were you two ever in the band together?
